text: Dong Nai attracts $2.42b in FDI in 10M

Southern Dong Nai city continued to record growth across several key economic indicators in the first 10 months of 2026, spanning industrial production, trade, services, investment attraction and international trade.

In terms of investment, as of October 20, registered foreign direct investment (FDI) exceeded $2.42 billion, equivalent to 80.68% of the city's annual target, according to Dong Nai's statistics authorities.
Meanwhile, registered domestic investment in projects both inside and outside industrial parks surpassed VND868.254 trillion (approximately $33 billion).
Industrial production also maintained strong momentum, with the cumulative industrial production index (IIP) rising 13.19% year-on-year over the 10-month period.

Total retail sales of goods and consumer service revenue were estimated at VND386.86 trillion ($14.7 billion), up 17.91% from the same period last year, reflecting continued expansion in domestic consumption and services.
The province's export turnover exceeded $30.5 billion in the first 10 months, while imports were estimated at approximately $21.7 billion.
